title: Angie: A Passion Fruit Gin Sour
ldName: Angie: A Passion Fruit Gin Sour
ldInstructionsRaw:
Add all of the ingredients to a shaker with ice. Shake to chill, then strain into the glass. Garnish.
Passion Fruit SyrupCombine 1 cup of passion fruit purée (such as Perfect Puree) and 1 cup of superfine sugar in a pot and boil. Allow to cool, then strain. Will keep in the refrigerator for 2 weeks.
